title: Evening Brief — Mon 23 Nov

stories.board: Nvidia brings back Huang; stocks soar
stories.headline: Nvidia rehires its boss, and the stock market has a huge day
stories.what: Nvidia's board gave Jensen Huang his CEO (top boss) job back, days after he quit during a review of his ties to a businesswoman some reports link to Chinese spies. Nvidia stock jumped about 31 percent, the S&P 500 rose about 4.7 percent and the Nasdaq about 6.5 percent.
stories.why: Nvidia makes the chips that power AI, so its trouble had dragged down the whole market last week.
stories.sides: President Trump backed Huang's return; Treasury Secretary Bessent said the government still wants answers, and some reports keep raising the spy concerns.

stories.board: World climate talks end with no deal
stories.headline: The big UN climate meeting in Turkey failed to agree
stories.what: COP31 (the yearly world climate meeting) in Antalya, Turkey ended with no main agreement after running two extra days. Countries fought over whether to mention fossil fuels (coal, oil and gas) and over money for poorer countries.
stories.why: These meetings set the world's plan for slowing climate change.
stories.sides: The EU and island nations rejected a draft that left out fossil fuels; Saudi Arabia and Russia pushed to remove them; climate groups blame rich countries too.

stories.board: Ukraine sinks Russian warship near Libya
stories.headline: Ukraine says its sea drones sank a Russian warship in Libya
stories.what: President Zelenskyy confirmed Ukrainian naval drones (robot boats) sank the Russian warship Merkury at a port in Libya, far from Ukraine. Ukraine also says it damaged a sanctioned (punished) Russian cargo ship.
stories.why: It shows the war between Russia and Ukraine is now reaching places far from the front line.
stories.sides: No major disagreement on the facts; the UN criticized drone attacks off Benghazi, Libya.

quick_hits: Canada's 2026 budget adds no new money for Jewish community security, even as threats and safety costs climb.
Israel still has no new government; Netanyahu and Eisenkot teams plan more talks after Sunday's meeting ended with no deal.
PM Carney joked about Trump with a Trump impersonator at Ottawa's Press Gallery Dinner.
big_picture: Wall Street cheered Nvidia's boss coming back, but the world could not agree on a climate plan.
